description: The plot illustrates the relative change in performance of a quantized Llama-3-8B-Instruct model when using SnapKV as a pruning method, with a baseline of 4 KV tokens at 4-bit precision. The x-axis represents the layers of the model, specifically Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32. The y-axis measures the relative change in performance, ranging from -15% to 5%. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different configuration of tokens and bit precision: LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit (yellow line with circle markers), LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit (red line with square markers), RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit (blue line with circle markers), and RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit (dark blue line with square markers). The baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit is represented by a dashed gray line. The plot shows that the relative change in performance varies across different layers and configurations, with some layers experiencing a decrease in performance, while others show an increase or remain relatively stable compared to the baseline.
